$comment: Code review output template with Architecture Compliance, LSP diagnostics. v1.4.0
$comment_determinism: All suggestion fields follow canonical format: {VERB} {SPECIFIC_TARGET} {CRITERION}. See rules/determinism.md Rule D-4.

blocking_issues.message: Circular dependency detected: cli-main → proxy-management → credential-storage → cli-main
blocking_issues.suggestion: Break cycle `cli-main → proxy-management → credential-storage → cli-main` by moving the dependency from `credential-storage` to `cli-main` to an event/callback interface until detect_circular_dependencies() reports no cycles in this path

blocking_issues.message: Layer violation: `credential-storage` (infrastructure) depends on `oauth-token-management` (core) — upward dependency
blocking_issues.suggestion: Move `oauth-token-management` from core layer to infrastructure layer OR remove dependency `credential-storage → oauth-token-management` until validate_layer_boundaries() reports no violations for `credential-storage`

blocking_issues.message: SQL injection: f-string used in DB query (users.py:42)
blocking_issues.suggestion: Replace f-string in `get_user()` (users.py:42) with `cursor.execute(query, (email,))` until no f-string/%-format is used in DB queries in this function
blocking_issues.code_snippet: query = f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '{email}'"

warnings.suggestion: Split `process_data()` (service.py:65-136) into sub-functions until each function in service.py:65-136 is ≤50 lines

warnings.message: Missing type hint for function parameter `data`
warnings.suggestion: Add type annotation to parameter `data` in `process_data()` (models.py:15) as `data: dict` until pyright reports no missing-type-hints for this function

code_review.$comment_suggestions: suggestions[] array is DEPRECATED (Rule D-5). Open-ended text recommendations without file:line are non-deterministic. Use WARNING/INFO findings instead.

lsp_diagnostics.$comment: Optional field - only present when lsp_status.status == 'READY'. lsp_diagnostics contain raw LSP data; canonical suggestion format applies where possible.
lsp_diagnostics.message: Type 'str' is not assignable to type 'int'
lsp_diagnostics.suggestion: Add type conversion wrapping `value` at service.py:45 as `int(value)` until pyright reportGeneralTypeIssues is resolved for this line

lsp_diagnostics.message: Variable 'unusedVar' is declared but never used
lsp_diagnostics.suggestion: Remove `unusedVar` declaration at app.ts:23 until TS6133 is resolved for this file

type_safety.$comment: issues: 1 regex warning (missing_type_hint, -5pts) + 1 LSP error (str->int, -10pts) + 1 LSP warning (unusedVar, -5pts). score = max(0, 10 - 5 - 10 - 5) = 0

$comment: architecture_available: true когда docs/architecture/overview.yaml существует и yq/jq доступны
Score calculation (Rule D-8): category_score = max(0, max_score - blocking×10 - warnings×5); total = Σ category_scores
LSP enhanced scoring: LSP error = -10pts, LSP warning = -5pts; LSP errors stay in lsp_diagnostics[], not in blocking_issues[]
Если architecture_available: false, веса пересчитываются: security(33) + code_quality(33) + error_handling(20) + type_safety(14)
